metadata.title: Linux Fundamentals
metadata.description: 36 original flag missions: beginner, intermediate and advanced command-line practice in a personal Linux simulation.

chapters.title: Beginner: first steps
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: First contact: read your dispatch
exercises.description: Read dispatch.txt in your home directory, copy the CYBER{...} flag, and submit it below.

exercises.title: Know your operator
exercises.description: Run whoami and id. Then read /home/user/operator.txt to collect your dispatch.

exercises.title: Your place in the tree
exercises.description: Inspect your location with pwd. Read coordinates.txt from that location.

exercises.title: The dispatch shelf
exercises.description: Locate the hidden dispatch in your home folder and read it.

chapters.title: Beginner: paths and discovery
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: Walk to the relay
exercises.description: Navigate into stations/relay and read message.txt, then return home.

exercises.title: Read without moving
exercises.description: Read /opt/academy/dispatch.txt without changing directory.

exercises.title: Ask the manual
exercises.description: Read man ls, then locate the hidden file inside /opt/academy/helpdesk.

exercises.title: One floor up
exercises.description: From /home/user/work, read ../store/receipt.txt.

chapters.title: Beginner: files and checkpoint
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: Names with spaces
exercises.description: Read the file named shift notes.txt.

exercises.title: Copy a field report
exercises.description: Create backup and copy report.txt to backup/report.txt. The reward file appears when the backup contains the original text.

exercises.title: Rename the incoming report
exercises.description: Rename incoming.txt to approved.txt without changing its content.

exercises.title: Beginner checkpoint: locate the parcel
exercises.description: Find the hidden parcel in /opt/academy/relay/archive and submit its flag.

chapters.title: Intermediate: search and selection
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: Search the relay log
exercises.description: Find the line containing RECEIPT in /var/log/relay.log and extract its flag.

exercises.title: Locate a filename
exercises.description: Find parcel.txt below /opt/academy and read it.

exercises.title: Inspect a batch with globbing
exercises.description: Read all .txt files inside batches to locate the receipt.

exercises.title: Select the last dispatch
exercises.description: Read only the last line of dispatches.txt.

chapters.title: Intermediate: streams and reports
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: Filter the signal
exercises.description: Filter stream.log down to the DELIVER line using a pipeline, then copy the flag.

exercises.title: Write a report
exercises.description: Write exactly relay ready followed by a newline to status.txt.

exercises.title: Append without erasing
exercises.description: Append restored as a second line in status.log, keeping the first line.

exercises.title: Separate repeated messages
exercises.description: Find the only nonduplicated line in messages.txt.

chapters.title: Intermediate: data and permissions
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: Extract a manifest field
exercises.description: Extract field 3 of manifest.txt, separated by colons.

exercises.title: Decode the shipment label
exercises.description: Decode label.b64 to reveal the flag.

exercises.title: Recover read permission
exercises.description: Inspect sealed.txt, restore owner read permission, and read it.

exercises.title: Intermediate checkpoint: process a manifest
exercises.description: Find the READY record in /var/log/manifest, extract its colon-separated payload, and decode that payload.

chapters.title: Advanced: composition and evidence
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: Read through standard input
exercises.description: Decode the receipt using base64 with input redirection.

exercises.title: Keep a copy of the evidence
exercises.description: Filter the OK line from source.log and save exactly that line to evidence.txt.

exercises.title: Spot a changed line
exercises.description: Compare before.txt and after.txt and recover the newly added flag.

exercises.title: Undo a reversed transmission
exercises.description: Reverse the characters of reversed.txt to recover the flag.

chapters.title: Advanced: variables and recovery
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: Store the route
exercises.description: Set DEST to /opt/academy/signal, then use "$DEST/receipt" to read the flag.

exercises.title: Traverse a locked directory
exercises.description: Restore owner traversal on vault, then read vault/receipt.

exercises.title: Recover after a failed check
exercises.description: Use test and || to create restored.txt containing recovered when missing.txt does not exist.

exercises.title: Count accepted records
exercises.description: Count lines containing ACCEPT in traffic.txt and write the count to count.txt.

chapters.title: Advanced: automation checkpoints
chapters.description: Original flag missions in your personal saved Linux environment.

exercises.title: Normalize a status stream
exercises.description: Translate status.txt to lowercase and save it as normalized.txt.

exercises.title: Order numeric priorities
exercises.description: Sort priorities.txt numerically and save the smallest value to first.txt.

exercises.title: Clean the staging folder
exercises.description: Remove the two temporary files in staging, then remove the empty staging directory. Preserve keep.txt.

exercises.title: Advanced checkpoint: restore the relay
exercises.description: Locate dispatch.dat under /opt/academy, select the RELEASE record, decode its second colon-delimited field, and save the decoded flag in /home/user/final.txt. Submit that flag.
